_comment: Links the engine makes in code between lists and the windows that fill them. Read by tests/GuiInvariants.Tests.ps1, tools/render_gui.py and tools/Invoke-GameCheck.ps1. Empty in this mod: its windows are scripted GUIs whose lists script fills (the 1440p UI mod keeps the rows of its reworked vanilla lists). Add a row only for a vanilla list this mod overrides.

variables._comment: File-level @variables of vanilla files whose windows the mod overrides. None here.
